infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Canvassing Tracker uses your location while you're clocked in to show your position on the neighborhood map and detect when you've left a house you just visited, so it can prompt you to log the outcome.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Canvassing Tracker needs background location while you're clocked in so it can keep tracking your route between houses and automatically stop tracking the moment you leave the neighborhood in a vehicle. Location is never collected outside your shift.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Canvassing Tracker needs background location while you're clocked in so it can track your canvassing route and automatically stop the moment you leave the neighborhood in a vehicle.
